messages.subject: yet another legend title question
parts:
please view:
http://ggplot2.googlegroups.com/web/legend.png?gsc=NlIgtRYAAAAF_FCrgcf9URwjXFJBYshrJSOjPK1WffO4K4u9A8p5SA

ggplot(myDataFrame[order(myDataFrame$cvCut),],aes(N50,totalCoverage))
+ geom_point(aes(size=as.factor(kmer)))
+ aes(colour=as.factor(cvCut))
+ scale_size_manual(name="kmer",value = kmerDotSizes)
+ geom_line()


I cannot seem to intuit how to rename the legend title "as.factor
(cvCut)" to "cvCut".

I don't mind a qplot() method but on that front I can't seem to figure
out how to replicate the lines between cvCut strata introduced by
geom_line() in ggplot()

thanks,
jerm

messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Re: yet another legend title question
parts:
You should be able to change the as.factor(cvCut) to whatever you want
by adding a

+ scale_colour_discrete('your title here')

into the mix, just like you did with scale_size_manual. You could
also make the code a lot cleaner by doing the ordering and making the
factors before hand and then incorporating the aes(colour... into the
geom_point command.

Does that help?

david.
